# Draft:47th Sports Emmy Awards

| previous = 46th

The 47th Sports Emmy Awards are scheduled to be presented by the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences (NATAS), honoring the best in American sports television coverage in 2025. The ceremony will take place in-person at the Jazz at Lincoln Center's Frederick P. Rose Hall in New York City on May 26, 2026. As he did the previous year, comedian, writer, and producer Roy Wood Jr. is set to host the ceremony.
Winners and nominees
The nominations were announced on March 25, 2026. The eligibility window for the nominations was the 2025 calendar year. Across the 47 categories, ESPN had the most nominations, with 63.
Lifetime Achievement Award
On April 21, 2026, Steve Bornstein, former president and CEO of NFL Network, was announced as the recipient of the Lifetime Achievement Award.
